c74object.name: evi.svfsmooth~
c74object.digest: Nonlinear TPT SVF filter with audio rate modulation and morphing capabilities
c74object.description:
evi.svfsmooth~ is a 'max define' for the evi_svfsmooth.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.svfsmooth~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
A cheap nonlinear 12dB multimode SVF for when you need a quick cheap synth filter. Morphing is between LP..BP..HP filters and is basic output-mixing with resonance attenuation, available at the far left outlet (1). All filters are also available individually via their multimode outlets 2, 3, 4 and 5 (lowpass, bandpass, highpass, notch).

inlet.digest: Inlet #2: Freq in Hz (default) or Pitch depending on 'cutoffmode' attribute
inlet.description: Cutoff frequency in Hz (default) or Pitch depending on the @cutoffmode attribute.
Smoothly interpolate 0..1 between lowpass..bandpass..highpass, available at the far left outlet 1.

attribute.name: cutoffmode
attribute.description: Switch cutoff frequency (inlet 2) between Pitch (on) or Hz (default off).

attribute.name: morphsmooth
attribute.description: If morphsmooth > 0, the 'Morph' control (inlet 4) will be internally smoothed by this time.

attribute.name: saturation
attribute.description: Internal integrator saturation in dB. Setting this too high will actually dull the filter. Best left at default +20 in most scenarios.

attribute.name: saturationsmooth
attribute.description: If saturationsmooth > 0, the @saturation attribute will be internally smoothed by this time. Default off.

c74object.discussion: For more information about other nonlinear SVF filters in evieve, see the 'evieve svf' tab of the helpfile.
